'''The Gamma Quadrant''' is the 23rd virtual expansion for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on January 30, 2015. The set consists of 56 cards. This set is part of the ''Deep Space Nine Block'' consisting of cards from [[Emissary]], [[Emissary: Supplemental]], [[Warp Pack: Emissary]], [[The Maquis]], and [[The Gamma Quadrant]],

==Type Breakdown==
*7 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*2 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*2 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (2 Dominion)
*7 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*6 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*3 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*22 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (3 Cardassian, 11 Dominion, 3 Ferengi, 6 Non-Aligned, and 3 Romulan)
*5 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (2 Dominion, 1 Federation, 1 Ferengi, and 1 Romulan)
*1 [[:Category:Site (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Site]]

NOTE: There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
